title: Review of c03's FCH cargo fission: S, I, D replicate on seed 7; the cargo contrast replicates but is equilibrium partitioning built into the coupling
summary: Re-ran world.py and world_chi0.py unchanged on fresh seed 7 (128^2, T=400). Micelles form from white noise by t=16 (37 bodies), divide in two synchronized waves (t~150-170 and t~310-340): 17 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges, 58 bodies at t=400. With c03's cargo_contrast.py every body holds the cargo at >= 7.4x the outside in every frame (aggregate 810-1210x); chi=0 gives the same bodies and splits (identical metrics) and contrast 2.0 at t=40 falling to 1.1. I support S, I, D. W replicates numerically, but I mark it by construction: the contrast is the Boltzmann factor of the imposed affinity chi u (exp(3 x ~2.2) ~ 10^3), with no boundary between cargo and outside.

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0: white noise everywhere; t=16: ~35 discrete micelles
observations.I: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=16-400: round bodies of fixed size, persistent between fission waves
observations.D: rerun/seed7/lineage.png: 17 persistent splits, max generation 3, 0 merges; dumbbells visible at t=156 and t=312 in the sheet
observations.W: rerun_contrast.txt: every body >= 7.4x the outside at every frame (aggregate 810-1210x) vs rerun_chi0_contrast.txt 1.1x by t=200

controls_run.W: rerun_chi0/seed7 (chi=0, same seed): identical bodies and splits, contrast 2.0 -> 1.1

verdicts.limitation: W: the cargo is pulled into amphiphile-rich regions by the imposed potential chi u; the contrast (~10^3) is the Boltzmann factor exp(|chi| delta u) that the coupling sets, as a dye partitions into oil drops. There is no boundary layer and no gate, so it does not show a body holding contents behind a wall, which is what C:inherited-contents asks; inheritance of the cargo is automatic because each daughter is amphiphile-rich. D is driven by the global amphiphile feed and synchronized (two waves), with the cargo passive (osm=0). I did not re-run the 1.5x resolution arm.
